title: National Theatre of Greece
geometryBasis: The named native theatre outline establishes the map placement. The theatre operator identifies the Ziller Building and the original Qualla photograph establishes the principal facade.
sectionBasis: Two principal exterior storeys. The street view shows a blue-gray rusticated lower level, pale upper wall and cornice, central arched colonnade, triangulated side window pediments and a partially open attic parapet.
limitations: The principal Ziller Building only. Separate venues and neighboring buildings are outside scope.
Published measurements of facade ornament, rear openings and roof heights were unavailable. Secondary elevations and fine ornament are approximate.
